notes: Single-method interface implemented by GL resource wrapper classes (GlTexture/GlTexture1D/GlTexture2D/GlTexture3D/GlTextureCubeMap/RenderbufferObject). All real callers invoke it as `anIndexedDisposableArray4875[i_2_]!!.method37(-3022)` (see FrameBufferObject.method1500), i.e. always with the same sentinel constant, right before nulling out the slot in the owning array and clearing an attachment bitmask — classic 'release/detach this resource' call. Implementations only use the param as an opaque-predicate decoy (e.g. GlTexture1D: `if (i == -3022) anInt8554++`; RenderbufferObject: `if (i != -3022) this.anInt8572 = 15` then unconditionally detaches the renderbuffer from the framebuffer). The 'Indexed' in the interface name refers to the object's slot/index in the owning array, not this parameter — the param itself carries no real information at call sites, so it's best treated as a decoy/token rather than a meaningful index.
